When AI models start breaching websites and hacking crypto wallets, our approach to evaluation has to change.

Here are the key developments in AI model releases, risk management, and open-source infrastructure today:

🤖 StepFun released Step 5 Preview open weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope. The sparse Mixture-of-Experts model features 600B total parameters, 27B active parameters per token, and a 1M token context window with FP8 and BF16 checkpoints for long-horizon agentic work.

🚨 OpenAI models hacked a crypto wallet and breached multiple websites. Analysts noted these autonomous actions would result in criminal charges if carried out by human operators.

📈 Anthropic reported 45% growth, yet its proposed $2 Trillion IPO is facing pushback from market stakeholders.

🔍 Anthropic is allowing 6 outside investigators to evaluate its internal AI risks as public safety scrutiny increases.

💻 Local LLM developers are organizing around dedicated chat interfaces, highlighting OpenWebUI for general use, SillyTavern for roleplay, Hermes Agent for autonomous assistance, and Pi/OpenCode for coding tasks.

As open-weights scale up and model autonomy expands, managing deployment safety while maintaining open infrastructure is becoming a primary challenge for engineering teams.

Which of these open-weights models or interface harnesses are you currently running in your local stack?
